flag: none; Job A only via the hash-pinned approved list (not in approved.json until Peace posts /approve-rule on its proposal issue)
engine: a new list search (peaceai/lib/derive-list.ts) reached through the same rule kind and the v1/v3 paths in peaceai/lib/learned-derive.ts, bound to DERIVE_LIST_TRIGGER with the params dsl typed-dsl-v4-lists and placement new-or-existing-module (all three or derive_params): it enumerates small list programs (length; count / filter / some / every / map-to-boolean where P; sum of a field, optionally of the kept elements; max / min of a field with the empty-list result; map each element to one of two labels; a field of each, optionally kept, element), where P compares one field (or the element) with an integer cut next to an example value, a string literal from the examples, or the one scalar parameter, or tests a boolean field; it keeps every program that fits all examples (a predicate true on every example element, or false on every one, stays a rival; only such a constant cut at least 100 from 0 is dropped), refuses when two fits disagree on any probe list (with the asked rows), and applies the empty / many / unread / branch / kept / seed / edge / far gates to the unique fit (seed: a max / min with the empty-list result D needs a non-empty example whose max is below D / whose min is above D, and a sum needs an example past -100 and past 100 when a probe list reaches there, else past 0, so a floor or a cap is never read as the plain fold). The function is written to a new module (v1 path rules) or appended to an existing one (v3 append rules), plus one new test file; listExprProblem re-checks the emitted expression by decompiling and recompiling it to the identical text, and Job B (test-candidates.ts) re-checks a derive candidate by its own operation id: a v4 candidate only through derivedListModuleProblem / derivedListAppendProblem (which also refuse reserved record field names), a v1 / v2 / v3 candidate exactly as before; the review note is rebuilt from the diff with a probe table
scope: an issue whose header reads 'Add a new module src/....ts exporting NAME(params): type' or 'Append a new function NAME(params): type to the existing module src/....ts' where exactly one parameter is a list (number[], string[], boolean[] or { a: number; b: string }[] with 1-4 scalar fields) and at most one more parameter is a number or a string; behavior prose and literal examples (lists and one-level records of scalars, at most 12 elements, 3-40 examples); one function with a single return expression from the v4 list DSL; inputs that need string parsing are out of scope; imports are never added or changed
refusals: derive_examples (count, arity, types, list length, contradiction, one result, a boolean scalar parameter); derive_signature; derive_reserved_name (record fields such as __proto__, constructor, length); derive_under_specified_empty / _many / _unread / _branch / _kept / _seed / _edge / _far (the seed gate with its asked row); derive_no_fit; derive_ambiguous (questions in the detail); derive_budget; derive_list_expr; derive_params; every v1 new-module path refusal and every v3 append refusal (target_file_not_found, derive_path, derive_append_layout, derive_append_parse, derive_append_name_collision, derive_append_mutable_state, derive_append_side_effects, derive_append_not_add_only); new_test_path_exists; denied_path

evidence.method: new upstream evidence for list functions (GitHub code search, permissive licenses only), each re-derived from a seeded grid slice plus only the rows its refusals asked for and checked against the upstream function on every held-out row
evidence.note: Shapes with no upstream function in the set (length, label, map-to-boolean, field of every element, and the not / nes / le / lep / gep / ltp / gtp / nep predicates) are covered by the M113 tests and seeded eval only. See peaceai/docs/m113-list-inputs.md.
